title: Composition of regular etale scalar units
statement: Let A, B and C be commutative rings in the coefficient universe and let φ : A → B, ψ : B → C, χ : A → C satisfy h : χ = ψ ∘ φ. For any scheme T, apply derived scalar extension along ψ to the hom of the representative-normalized regular scalar unit along φ, then compose with the regular scalar unit along ψ. This equals the fixed derived scalar-extension compositor pbcFixedScalarExtensionComp(φ, ψ, χ, h), evaluated at the derived tensor unit over A, followed by the regular scalar unit along χ. The unit and compositor are those of [def-pur-exceptional-coefficient-normalizations] and [def-weil-pbc-witness-compatibility]; there is no flatness or boundedness assumption.

source.place: Paragraphs 1--3, ordinary regular-unit normalization and passage to derived coefficients

proof.text: For the ordinary restriction functors, pass to presheaves with the monoidal unit of the sheaf inclusion. The sheafCompose unit formula reduces composition of the three ordinary lax units to the corresponding presheaf equation. On every section the latter is ψ(φ(a)) = (ψ ∘ φ)(a); the restriction compositor has identity sections.

Identify all three transported derived regular units with exact-single adjunction insertions. Apply the insertion composition theorem to the ordinary unit equation and the canonical restriction compositor. The left-adjoint compositor in that theorem is definitionally pbcFixedScalarExtensionComp.

Use naturality of the left-adjoint compositor at the single/unit isomorphism. Cancel that isomorphism on the source and the inverse single/unit isomorphism on the target; cancel the middle single/unit isomorphism with its inverse. This yields the equation at the actual derived tensor units.

proof_origin.place: P2: sectionwise restriction unit composition, exact adjunction insertion composition, and naturality of the canonical single/unit identifications

lean.statement:
theorem normalizedScalarUnit_comp
    {A B C : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    (φ : A →+* B) (ψ : B →+* C) (χ : A →+* C) (hχ : χ = ψ.comp φ)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) :
    (Etale.scalarExtension ψ T).map (Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.unitIso φ T).hom ≫
      (Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.unitIso ψ T).hom =
    (ProEtale.pbcFixedScalarExtensionComp T.smallEtaleTopology φ ψ χ hχ).hom.app
      (Etale.constantComplex A T) ≫ (Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.unitIso χ T).hom
